# Bicep fixtures

Sources compiled by the Bicep CLI; committed `*.arm.json` and `diagnostics/*.stderr` are generated by
`scripts/ci/regen-bicep-fixtures.sh` (Bicep CLI 0.47.16). See `docs/development/bicep-adapter.md`.

- `spike/`: ADR-002 spike sources (original, array-form ARM).
- `foundry/`, `foundry-v2/`: original Foundry account/project fixture (array form and symbolic form).
- `synthetic/`: copy of the Azure/azure-dev `azure.ai.projects` synthesis templates (commit afe4b2b4d262),
  MIT licence, Copyright 2022 (c) Microsoft Corporation; see `synthetic/LICENSE-azure-dev`. Unmodified.
- `params/`: `.bicepparam` cases for environment-variable handling.
